title: Bridging Semantics and Behavior: An Agent-Based Evolutionary Model of Topic Competition with BERTopic
summary: Understanding how information spreads and opinions evolve on social media is a core challenge in computational social science. Users constantly face competing topics, yet their decisions to engage are shaped by social learning, perceived utility, and cognitive limits. Traditional models often separate content from behavior, missing how individual cognition and social interaction jointly drive large-scale discourse.
